issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of dentistry provided for in 2-15-1732. ... "Department" means the department of labor and industry provided for in Title 2, chapter 15, part 17.

moral_character_required.quote: three affidavits of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduation from a board-approved dental school
degree_required.quote: a certificate of graduation from a board-approved dental school

accrediting_body.quote: the board shall be guided by the standards, canons, and practices required for recognition by the commission on dental accreditation

exams.name: National Board Examination
exams.quote: certification of successful completion of the national board examination

exams.name: Regional Board Examination
exams.quote: certification of successful completion of a regional board examination

available.quote: the board shall issue a license to practice without examination to a person licensed in another state if the board determines that the other state's license standards at the time of application to this state are substantially equivalent to or greater than the standards in this state

requirements.value: License standards in the other state must be substantially equivalent to or greater than Montana standards; no pending charges or final disciplinary action for unprofessional conduct or impairment.
requirements.quote: the other state's license standards at the time of application to this state are substantially equivalent to or greater than the standards in this state; and there is no reason to deny the license under the laws of this state

regulatory_model.quote: Applicants for licensure shall submit an application that must include, when required

credential_type.quote: Applicants for licensure shall submit an application that must include, when required

is_mandatory.quote: a person is practicing dentistry under this chapter if the person ... uses the words "dentist", "dental surgeon", or "oral surgeon", the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or any other words, letters, title, or descriptive matter that in any way represents the person as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe, or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of human teeth, jaws, or adjacent structures

title_protection.quote: appending the word "dentist" or the letters "D.D.S.", "D.M.D.", or similar letters to a person's name on a door or a sign, in a printed or published form, or in any other type of advertisement is prima facie evidence that the person is engaged in the practice of dentistry and is subject to the regulations, convictions, and penalties of this chapter

scope_protection.quote: a person is practicing dentistry under this chapter if the person: (a) performs, attempts, advertises to perform, causes to be performed by the patient or any other person, or instructs in the performance of dental operations, oral surgery, or dental service of any kind

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is physically or mentally impaired by habitual intemperance or excessive use of addictive drugs, alcohol, or any other drug or substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a licensee is physically or mentally impaired by habitual intemperance or excessive use of addictive drugs, alcohol, or any other drug or substance or by mental illness or chronic physical illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee fails or refuses to comply with a reasonable request to undergo a mental, physical, or chemical dependency evaluation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee fails or refuses to comply with a reasonable request that the licensee undergo a mental, physical, or chemical dependency evaluation or a combination of evaluations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee fails or refuses to undergo or satisfactorily complete a recommended course of treatment or aftercare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee fails or refuses to undergo a reasonable course of treatment that the program personnel recommend, including reasonable aftercare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee's condition creates a risk of harm to the licensee, a patient, or others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee's condition creates a risk of harm to the licensee, a patient, or others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing false information in a licensure application or failure to furnish required information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the required information, except pursuant to 37-1-138, or the filing of false information is grounds for denial or revocation of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding of unprofessional conduct by an applicant or license holder, impose a sanction provided by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly defrauding, abusing, or aiding in the defrauding or abusing of the workers' compensation system
disciplinary_grounds.quote: suspend, revoke, or deny a license of a person who the board determines, after a hearing as provided in subsection (1)(b), is guilty of knowingly defrauding, abusing, or aiding in the defrauding or abusing of the workers' compensation system

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee in a medical assistance program returns to use of a prohibited substance on three separate occasions during the contract period
disciplinary_grounds.quote: take disciplinary action against the license of a person in a medical assistance program under chapter 3, 4, 7, or 8 if, in the period under contract, the licensee has on three separate occasions returned to the use of a prohibited or proscribed substance

definition_quote.value: a person is practicing dentistry under this chapter if the person: (a) performs, attempts, advertises to perform, causes to be performed by the patient or any other person, or instructs in the performance of dental operations, oral surgery, or dental service of any kind gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other remuneration paid or to be paid, directly or indirectly, to the person, any other person, or any agency
definition_quote.quote: a person is practicing dentistry under this chapter if the person: (a) performs, attempts, advertises to perform, causes to be performed by the patient or any other person, or instructs in the performance of dental operations, oral surgery, or dental service of any kind gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other remuneration paid or to be paid, directly or indirectly, to the person, any other person, or any agency

value: diagnosis and treatment of diseases/conditions of human teeth, jaws, and adjacent structures
correction of malpositions of teeth or jaw
administration of anesthetics in connection with dental operations
methods_authorized.quote: performs, attempts, advertises to perform, causes to be performed by the patient or any other person, or instructs in the performance of dental operations, oral surgery, or dental service of any kind

drug_authority.value: May administer anesthetics in connection with dental operations, subject to limitations in 37-4-511; deep sedation and general anesthesia require continual monitoring of vital signs by another trained health care professional and proper facility equipment.
drug_authority.quote: administers an anesthetic of any nature, subject to the limitations provided in 37-4-511, in connection with a dental operation

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: "Deep sedation" means a drug-induced depression of consciousness ... "General anesthesia" means a drug-induced loss of consciousness

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "direct supervision" means treatment by a dental auxiliary or licensed dental hygienist provided with the intent and knowledge of the dentist. The treatment must be performed while the dentist is on the premises. ... "general supervision" means treatment by a licensed dental hygienist provided with the intent and knowledge of the dentist licensed and residing in the state of Montana. The supervising dentist need not be on the premises. ... "public health supervision" means the provision of limited dental hygiene preventative services without the prior authorization or presence of a licensed dentist in a public health facility.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist practicing under public health supervision shall obtain a limited access permit from the board.

value: patients or residents of facilities or programs who, due to age, infirmity, disability, or financial constraints, are unable to receive regular dental care
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: The provision of services under a limited access permit is limited to patients or residents of facilities or programs who, due to age, infirmity, disability, or financial constraints, are unable to receive regular dental care.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: when a medical practitioner or a naturopathic physician authorized to prescribe an opioid prescribes an opioid to an opioid-naive patient on an outpatient basis, the prescription may not be for more than a 7-day supply

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A licensed dentist who employs or engages the services of a person, firm, or corporation to construct, reproduce, make, alter, or repair bridges, crowns, dentures, other prosthetic appliances, surgical appliances, or orthodontic appliances shall furnish the person, firm, or corporation with a written work authorization

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: All nonmetal full dentures shall be permanently identified with the first and last name of the owner at the time of processing the dentures.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A person licensed under this title to provide health care in the ordinary course of business or practice of a profession may provide services by means of telehealth when the use of telehealth: (a) is appropriate for the services being provided; (b) meets the standard of care for delivery of services

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: the board shall authorize the administration of local anesthetic agents by a licensed dental hygienist certified by the board to administer the agents under the general supervision and authorization of a licensed dentist

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist practicing under public health supervision shall obtain a limited access permit from the board.
